rules.rule: Fox Orange #FF5A1F appears in the type, panels, shapes or background of every design, not only inside Scrap.
No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, outlines, panels, shapes, icons or backgrounds.
Title words are filled Signal White, Acid Signal or Fox Orange.
Inter lines on Jet Black are Signal White, Acid Signal or Fox Orange.
Inter lines on Static Purple are Signal White or Acid Signal.
Inter lines on Signal White are Jet Black or Static Purple.
Inter lines on Fox Orange are Jet Black.
Acid Signal is never a ground or panel.
Leaving title-word fills aside, Acid Signal covers no more than 10% of the designed, non-footage area.
Type, outlines, panels and shapes use palette colours solid at 100% opacity, with no tint, partial transparency, blur, gradient or blend mode.
In the films, every held frame, including the final end card, is solid and unblurred (motion blur only while elements move).
